summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of the new AI bank reconciliation feature (business owner + accountant). All 10 flows in the review request are working. AI suggestions endpoint returns in ~15-25s with 12 well-reasoned Greek suggestions, 10 pre-selected (confidence>=75). Approving via ai-apply-selected correctly (a) marks 'match' txs as Συμφωνημένη with 'Ίδιο ποσό' note, (b) creates λοιπή κίνηση entries with correct kind for 'entry' suggestions (Τόκοι/Ανάληψη επιχειρηματία/Λοιπή πληρωμή/Προμήθεια-έξοδα τράπεζας/Φόροι-εισφορές), (c) updates KPIs (Extrait προς συμφωνία 12→2), (d) learns 10 rules with per-counterparty keyword+action+entryKind+target+hits. Rule delete works (10→9 with 'Ο κανόνας διαγράφηκε' toast). apply-rules-btn on remaining unmatched with no matching rule returns '1 εκκρεμούν'. Split matching: candidate list rendered (8 candidates for the 930 EMVASMA tx), over-allocation (744+500=1244>930) rejected with clear Greek toast 'Το σύνολο (1244 €) υπερβαίνει το ποσό της κίνησης (930 €).'; exact split 744+186=930 succeeds with toast 'Η κίνηση επιμερίστηκε σε 2 παραστατικά (930 €).' and the row status becomes 'Συμφωνημένη · Επιμερισμός σε 2: ΤΠ-0002: 744 € · ...'. Partial allocation (100€ on the 3210€ tx) succeeds with note 'Επιμερισμός σε 1: ΤΠΥ-0003: 100 € · υπόλοιπο κίνησης 3110.08 €'. Office/accountant flows: /office/banking renders data-testid=office-banking-table with columns Πελάτης/Λογαριασμοί/Ασυμφώνητες/Εισροές/Εκροές/Παλαιότερη, the client checkbox is DISABLED when access level != full and ENABLED after resetting to Πλήρης πρόσβαση; office-bulk-reconcile is present and clickable. Client 360 (/office/clients/<orgId>) shows the new 'Ασυμφώνητες τραπεζικές' KPI with the correct count (0 after all reconciliations). Regression: /banking overview, Αυτόματη συμφωνία button, Σύνδεση manual dialog and Εισαγωγή CSV button are all present and unaffected. No console errors, no 500s.

integration_issues.flow: office-bulk-reconcile toast when there are 0 unmatched transactions
integration_issues.issue: When the selected client has 0 unmatched bank transactions (our scenario after full reconciliation), clicking data-testid=office-bulk-reconcile completed without any visible sonner toast. Review spec says a 'per-client result toast' should appear. Not blocking, but suggest emitting toast.info('0 κινήσεις προς συμφωνία') so operators get positive feedback even when there is nothing to do. Could not verify the happy-path toast because no clients currently have unmatched inflow/outflow on demo seed after AI approval.

After deleting a rule and clicking apply-rules-btn with 1 unmatched tx that no longer has a matching rule, the toast text is just '1 εκκρεμούν' (a fragment). Consider a full Greek sentence such as 'Καμία κίνηση δεν ταίριαξε με τους κανόνες — 1 εκκρεμούν' for clarity.

verified_features: Panel renders on /banking/<id>?tab=statement with data-testid=apply-rules-btn, ai-suggest-btn, split-tx-list.

ai-suggest-btn → data-testid=ai-suggestions-list with 12 rows (data-testid=ai-suggestion-<txId>, ai-select-<txId>). Confidence>=75 pre-selected (10/12). Badges show kind (Ταύτιση παραστατικού / Λοιπή κίνηση: <Greek kind> / Παράβλεψη), amount, date, Greek reason, target document.

ai-apply-selected performs the actual work: invoice matches create payments (row: Συμφωνημένη · 'Ίδιο ποσό ...'), entry suggestions create λοιπή κίνηση with correct kind (Τόκοι/Ανάληψη επιχειρηματία/Λοιπή πληρωμή/Προμήθεια-έξοδα τράπεζας/Φόροι-εισφορές). Extrait KPI drops from 12→2.
Rules learned automatically: data-testid=bank-rules-list shows 10 rules (keyword + action label + entryKind + target + hits).
rule-delete-<id> deletes a rule (10→9) with 'Ο κανόνας διαγράφηκε' toast and refresh.
apply-rules-btn runs and toasts a result ('1 εκκρεμούν' when no rule matches remaining tx).

split-open-<txId> opens split-dialog with candidate list; alloc-input-<candId> present per candidate. Over-allocation rejected with precise Greek error including the offending totals. Exact split (744+186 on 930€) succeeds and creates two payments — verified via row note 'Επιμερισμός σε 2: ΤΠ-0002: 744 € · ...'. Partial allocation (100 on 3210) succeeds with 'υπόλοιπο κίνησης 3110.08 €' note.
/office/banking office-banking-table renders correctly; disabled checkbox for read-only access clients and enabled after access→full; office-bulk-reconcile clickable.
Client 360 (/office/clients/<orgId>) 'Ασυμφώνητες τραπεζικές' KPI renders with correct value (0 post-reconciliation).
Regression: /banking overview cards, Αυτόματη συμφωνία button, Σύνδεση manual dialog trigger, and Εισαγωγή extrait (CSV) button unaffected.
action_items: (LOW) Fire an info toast on office-bulk-reconcile when there are no unmatched transactions to give feedback.
(LOW) Improve the apply-rules-btn Greek toast to a full sentence when no rule matched any remaining tx (currently just '1 εκκρεμούν').

(SEED / INFO) demo@timologio.gr↔office@koletsas.gr accountant link was left at 'μόνο ανάγνωση' by iteration_22. During this run I reset it to 'Πλήρης πρόσβαση' so the office checkbox becomes enabled — main agent may want to persist this in seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: ai-reconcile-panel.tsx correctly gates all mutations behind useTransition/pending — good UX; router.refresh() called after each action so the parent page (server component) re-fetches unmatched counts and rules.
Split-dialog uses per-candidate <Input type=number step=0.01 max={remaining}> — server still validates over-allocation, correct defense-in-depth.
Rule learning is idempotent (hits increments); good pattern.

The AI endpoint POST /api/copilot/bank-match responded in ~15s for 12 tx — within tolerable UX; a progress hint under ai-suggest-btn (e.g., 'Αναλύεται...' + estimated time) would further improve perceived latency.
office-banking-table uses data-testid=office-bank-select-<orgId> and office-bulk-reconcile — consistent naming.
Regression risk: after reconciliation, the split-tx-list card disappears when unmatchedTxs is empty — desired behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (10/10 verified). One flow (bulk-reconcile positive toast with unmatched >0) could not be exercised because seed had 0 unmatched after full AI approval.
